description:
Claude Code made an entire AI video for me using Google Flow and CapCut—and I never manually edited a single clip. From the story and AI voiceover to consistent characters, motion graphics, music, captions, and a finished CapCut timeline, Claude handled the entire production.

In this step-by-step tutorial, I'll show you how to automate video creation with Claude Code, Google Flow, and my free CapCut Story Film skill.

We'll create a cinematic sci-fi short film called *The Voice Under Europa* from scratch. Claude writes the storyboard, generates the narration, creates character-consistent images in Google Flow, animates the scenes with camera movements and lighting, builds motion graphics using HyperFrames, and assembles everything into an editable CapCut project.

No manually keyframing pictures. No editing clips one by one. And no need to generate expensive AI video clips—this workflow brings still images to life with motion, music, and sound design.

🎁 **GET THE FREE CAPCUT STORY FILM SKILL + SETUP CHECKLIST:** https://growsembly.com/builders

▶ **Fully Automate Google Flow Using Claude Code:**
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JEla_mdlfxs

▶ **How to Make Consistent AI Characters and Videos in Google Flow:**
https://youtu.be/0-gZXWyZGzg

**TOOLS USED**

Claude Code: https://claude.com/download

CapCut Desktop: https://www.capcut.com

Google AI Studio: https://aistudio.google.com/api-keys

Google Flow, Flow MCP, and HyperFrames are also part of this workflow.

**CHAPTERS**

0:00 Claude Made the Entire Video

0:25 How the AI Video Automation Skill Works

1:20 Install Claude Code, CapCut & the Free Skill

2:20 Connect Google Flow MCP and AI Voices

3:25 Turn One Idea into a Complete AI Film

4:50 Generate AI Narration and Storyboard Timing

5:35 Create Consistent Characters and Scenes in Google Flow

7:05 Automate Video Editing, Motion Graphics & Sound

8:40 Build the Finished CapCut Timeline

9:15 Watch the AI-Made Film and Get the Skill

**WHAT YOU'LL LEARN**

How to use Claude Code to make complete AI videos, automate CapCut editing, generate consistent AI characters with Google Flow, create cinematic motion graphics, and build a repeatable AI filmmaking workflow for YouTube videos, documentaries, short films, and faceless content.

The skill is free to download. Claude Code access and Google Flow availability depend on your account and plan.

#ClaudeCode #GoogleFlow #AIVideoEditing
